dependencies.evidence: Expected-failure fixtures and baseline harness present on approved base: ui-catalog admission (packages/core/ui-admission.ts admitArtifactContents rejects undeclared actions, dangling bindings, stale revisions), trusted component catalog (packages/core/ui-catalog.ts SURFACE_LIMITS 200 nodes/12 depth/128KiB), public-source allowlist (scripts/public-source-files.json + tests/public-source.test.ts). M01-verification.json records the same platform.credential-lease BLOCKED gate observed again here.

Single-use expiring approvals consumed before any verification execution: approvalSchema/actionCommitment, recipeApprovalCommitment and consumeRecipeApproval in packages/core/project-verification.ts reuse packages/contracts/tool-effects.ts. Cancelled or exhausted approvals are rejected before worker or launcher creation (tests/qa-delegation-v3.test.ts, tests/verification-v3.test.ts).

Proven execution-profile contracts on approved base: sha256HexSchema, rootRelativePathSchema and implementationEvidenceV3Schema reused from packages/contracts/execution-profile.ts; host flag registry (packages/core/host-flags.ts) extended with verification.workflowV1 default false. M03-verification.json present on base (docs/implementation/v3/M03-verification.json, outcome PARTIAL on the same credential-lease gate).

core.detail: packages/contracts/verification.ts defines strict zod contracts: fixed phase order (VERIFICATION_PHASE_NAMES), workspace identity (dev/ino + canonical root), executable/configuration digests captured before execution, observation freshness CURRENT|STALE|INDETERMINATE derived not stored, completionLabel Verified|Completed unverified|Failed|Blocked, SecurityFindingV1, browserChecklistSchema strict step union with BROWSER_STEP_LIMIT=24, 15s step timeout, 5min run deadline, approved origins. A screenshot or JSON schema alone cannot create PASS: visual assertions require a recorded screenshot digest and an executed driver step.

core.stage: Approved project recipe runner with source-drift and digests recompare
core.detail: ProjectVerificationService.runRecipe (packages/core/project-verification.ts) requires a consumed single-use approval bound to recipe+workspace digests, captures source/dependency digests before phases, runs BUILD/TEST/START/READINESS sequentially (failure prevents later phases), verifies readiness against the launched process tree plus the expected listener on an approved loopback endpoint (a stale-server 200 yields READINESS_OWNER_UNPROVEN), always runs TEARDOWN terminating only owned processes and records cleanup failures as observations. Source digests are recomputed; identity change throws BLOCKED_SOURCE_DRIFT.

core.stage: Browser verification with fresh profile, strict step union and origin policy
core.detail: runBrowserChecklist (packages/core/browser-verification.ts) launches a fresh profile through an injected BrowserDriver, enforces the strict step union, caps steps at 24/15s/5min, refuses navigation and network traffic to non-approved origins, collects bounded console/network failures, persists VisualObservationV1 rows through Store.internal only, and records BLOCKED (never fabricated PASS) when a required assertion lacks a screenshot or the driver crashes.

core.stage: QA delegation role, bounded repair loop, security finding ledger
core.detail: createQaWorkerRole exposes only verification.run/verification.observe/context.read with an empty tool whitelist and no recursive spawn; admitQaSpawn requires a live single-use approval and rejects cancelled requests before worker creation. BoundedRepairLoop stops at MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS=3, on unchanged failure digest twice, revoked approval, requirement conflict, or VERIFIED; QA never commits (no write tools). SecurityFindingLedger dedupes by source+identity and keeps the first evidence quality record.

computeAssessment produces DeliverableAssessmentV1: Verified only when every required check has fresh trusted evidence and no unresolved external effect; otherwise 'completed but unverified' naming the exact missing checks, Failed, or Blocked. observationFreshness derives STALE when the observed source digest differs from the current source cut; historical outcomes are never rewritten. task_finish calls completionAssessment inside the same store transaction (synchronous sourceDigestSync, no awaits) and stores an 'assessment' record; Thread.status is retained unchanged. New ui tool verification_declare (WORKSPACE_WRITE, store binding, approval none) binds declared requirements to the thread; gated by host flag verification.workflowV1 (default false, env HARNESS_FLAG_VERIFICATION_WORKFLOW_V1 only).

core.stage: Generated-UI endurance via the trusted catalog path
core.detail: tests/generated-ui-endurance-v3.test.ts exercises the existing trusted catalog/admission path without re-enabling any disabled capability: unknown component, >200 nodes, depth>12, >128KiB and dangling refs are rejected; the M01 broken-button fixture fails INVALID_SPEC for its intended reason then the repaired fixture passes; a stale request revision yields STALE_REQUEST until refreshed; missing request yields CAPABILITY_DENIED; unknown action route yields INVALID_SPEC; GENERATED_APPS_ENABLED remains true.

integration.detail: GET /api/threads/:id/verification (apps/server/server.ts) returns the additive verificationPanelModel read model with Cache-Control no-store and the standard archived/NOT_FOUND handling. apps/web/src/VerificationPanel.tsx renders requirement|observed check|source revision|outcome|freshness|verifier|evidence rows with text labels plus colors, a Stale banner (stale rows cannot render green), the completion summary label, repair attempt/budget and security finding evidence quality; it polls the route every 4s and mounts in App.tsx only when data exists. shell.css gained 13 .verification-* rules (CRLF preserved).

call.name 'verification_declare' routes through the existing uiTool path inside store.command; with the host flag off the tool is denied. task_finish records the assessment projection; the panel is an additive read model and changes no existing surface when no verification data exists.

integration.stage: Public source and staged build admission
integration.detail: All new source files admitted to scripts/public-source-files.json (source list: 5 modules + VerificationPanel + 4 test files + this evidence file; runtime list: the 5 host modules). The staged host/worker esbuild resolves cleanly (tests/public-source.test.ts passes).

3145 passed / 54 failed / 52 skipped of 3251. Failures match the M01-recorded baseline classes: 60s timeouts in Store/remote-operation fixtures, missing windows-credential-lease.node (lease build blocked), absent isolated Hermes Python runtime, missing model credentials. The two branch-caused failures (flag registry count, public-source runtime staging) were fixed; integrations/integration-host/review-host failures reproduce identically on the base checkout.

Failure classes are environmental: 'chrome' channel absent (settings-* specs), POSIX 'exec' webServer commands unsupported on Windows (files-reading, file-checkpoints, conversation-find), fixture locators absent and alert-locator timeouts on a loaded host. Baseline repro: wo8 fails identically at the base checkout (same 8 tests, same missing .surface-metric/.everyday-comparison-table locators); unit-suite suspects reproduce identically at base. migration.detail: No data migration. verification.workflowV1 defaults false; observations, declarations, assessments and security findings are new additive store kinds; no existing records were rewritten and Thread.status semantics are unchanged.

rollback: Unset HARNESS_FLAG_VERIFICATION_WORKFLOW_V1 (default false) to disable verification_declare and recipe execution paths; the panel read model renders nothing when no verification data exists. Rollback removes only the new modules, the uiTool branch, the task_finish assessment projection, the server route, the panel component/styles and the manifest entries; historical verification observations are retained in the store, not rewritten. No existing policy was loosened to recover availability.
